comment: Which of a zone's layer filters (its LVB's layer sets, by ID) the client is told to show (ZoneInit's and ActorSetPos' transition_territory_filter_key), by quest progress. Retail's server picks it; the client's layout shows a layer only if its filter list has (or, for some, hasn't) that key, and with 0 in a zone like these every stage of the story stands there at once (Bob's Waking Sands screenshot, 2026-10-26). For each territory, the last entry whose quest has been accepted or completed applies (an entry without one is the default). Recorded: Bob's Chronofoil capture afe32479 visit 0.10 (2026-10-25), the Waking Sands during The Scions of the Seventh Dawn (509): 90338 in ZoneInit at its last step and in the ActorSetPos after it was completed; 90339 in the ActorSetPos as A Wild Rose by Any Other Name (510) was accepted, and after. Bob's Chronofoil capture b8432613 (2026-10-27): 90339 through Lord of the Inferno (343); 90340 in the ActorSetPos as A Hero in the Making (511) was accepted, and in ZoneInit to its end and The Company You Keep (Twin Adder, 680) being accepted; 90341 in ZoneInit once Wood's Will Be Done (683, the Twin Adders' next step; 684 and 685 are the other two companies' and taken to be the same) was accepted; 90342 in the ActorSetPos as Sylph-management (513, which follows any of the three) was accepted.
